description: Update Actual Production Quantity associated with the specific Project.

id.description: Unique identifier for this actual production quantity record.

description.description: Free-text note describing work performed or conditions affecting the production quantity entry.

earned_production_quantity_id.description: The ID of the associated Earned Production Quantity in the Production Tracking system

unit_of_measure.description: Unit of measure for the quantity value, such as square feet (Sf) or linear feet (Lf). Inherited from the associated cost code.

quantity.description: Numeric amount of work installed, measured in the associated unit_of_measure.

timesheet_id.description: Identifier of the timesheet this production quantity is linked to. When set, the timesheet's date is used for the production quantity regardless of the date field.

parent_id.description: Identifier of this location's parent in the location hierarchy. Null for top-level locations.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of last update to the location, in ISO 8601 format.
